block.guhs.droomkraampje.lore: The Sandguh's stall on the Dream Square. Click it: dream things for dream sand!
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.label: zzz
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.leeg: The stall is still empty... the Sandguh is napping.
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.kleine_lettertjes: Paid with dream sand. A dream sand block counts as 9; you get your change back.
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.grap.2: "Buy something and get a yawn for free."
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.grap.3: "Dream sand is not beach sand. Neither is vadsigheid."
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.grap.4: "Zzz... oh, a customer! Have a look around."
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.tekort: You're %s dream sand short. Catch some stars!
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.nee.max: You already have that one. One is enough, says the Sandguh.
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.nee.onbekend: That isn't here (any more). Dreamt it, maybe?
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.nee.mislukt: That went wrong; your dream sand is back.
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.blub_knuffel.uitleg: A Blub plushie of a random wild Blub: which kind, meter and size? Surprise!
gui.guhs.droomwinkel.bed.uitleg: A brand new bed, fresh from the dream.
advancements.guhs.quest.droomwinkel_geko: Buy something in the dream shop
